rv.q: The sketches in 'Latinologues' are uneven, but when they work, they capture the texture of contemporary Latino life with humor and insight.
As the odd gringo out in the audience, duty compels me to report that the cheerful folks surrounding me did seem to find Mr. Najera's broad-brush portraits of Latino experience endearing.

cn.t: This comic revue about Latino life features uneven sketches that occasionally land with humor and insight, though the ethnic humor feels hit-or-miss overall.
